en_note: Machine translation by Claude (my reading), not on Pesna.org and not checked by a native speaker. Treat it as a study aid.
translator_notes: About Karpos, the leader of the 1689 uprising, said to have been impaled; the song says hanged. No named author, so translated. 'клета' (cursed) applied to the mother is my reading.

lines.en: The drum beats through the town of Skopje,

lines.cyr: ќе ми го бесат селанецот млад,
lines.lat: ḱe mi go besat selanecot mlad,
lines.en: they are going to hang the young villager,
Karpos the voivode, bold, a hero, young,
Karpos the voivode, bold, a hero, young.

lines.cyr: Вардар матен тече, бурни води пие,
lines.lat: Vardar maten teče, burni vodi pie,
lines.en: The Vardar flows muddy, drinks stormy waters,

lines.cyr: стои мајка му, стара, жена, слепа,
lines.lat: stoi majka mu, stara, žena, slepa,
lines.en: his mother stands, old woman, blind,

lines.cyr: својот син го даде во борбата клета,
lines.lat: svojot sin go dade vo borbata kleta,
lines.en: she gave her son to the cursed struggle,

lines.cyr: стои мајка му, стара, жена, клета,
lines.lat: stoi majka mu, stara, žena, kleta,
lines.en: his mother stands, old woman, cursed,

lines.cyr: својот син го даде во борбата клета.
lines.lat: svojot sin go dade vo borbata kleta.
lines.en: she gave her son to the cursed struggle.

lines.cyr: Со бесилка на вратот, стои, Карпош, смел,
lines.lat: So besilka na vratot, stoi, Karpoš, smel,
lines.en: With a noose on his neck stands Karpos, bold,
he gave his life for freedom,
he gave his life for freedom,
he gave his life for freedom.
